title: elaphoglossum scolopendrifolium
intro: Elaphoglossum scolopendrifolium, commonly known as the scolopendra fern, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Elaphoglossum scolopendrifolium include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which may help in protecting against cell damage and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
